latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Meta Tags Optimizer.

- Generates and optimizes meta tags, including title tags, meta descriptions, Open Graph tags, and Twitter cards.
- Designed to increase click-through rates (CTR) and enhance social sharing previews.
- Includes step-by-step guidance for creating new meta tags or optimizing existing ones.
- Supports manual data input and integration with SEO tools for automated data collection.
- Provides structured, recommendation-based outputs with clear rationale for each suggestion.
